candidates.title: Rattling Parcel
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a fragile gift box began rattling on the way to the celebration before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they hurried onward, but the rattling grew worse on every uneven stone; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the wrapping had shifted and left a delicate ornament unprotected; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they repacked the box with soft cloth and completed the delivery carefully, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Shadow Lantern
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a strange shadow from the lantern frightened the younger animals before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they moved the lantern away, but the shadow grew larger across the wall; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a paper cutout behind the glass was making the enormous silhouette; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they removed the cutout and taught everyone how shadows change with distance, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Waterlogged Book
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered rain soaked the history book that held the village's oldest recipe before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they placed it near a hot stove, but the damp pages began to curl; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized dry blotting paper could draw out moisture without scorching the ink; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they dried the pages gently and saved the handwritten recipe for the cooks, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
